WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) + SUM(CASE WHEN er.extra_type IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN er.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_conceded
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.extra_runs er 
        ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(wt.player_out) AS wickets_taken
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    JOIN ipl.main.wicket_taken wt 
        ON b.match_id = wt.match_id AND b.over_id = wt.over_id AND b.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND b.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    WHERE wt.kind_out IN ('caught', 'bowled', 'stumped', 'lbw', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket')
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    br.runs_conceded,
    bw.wickets_taken,
    br.runs_conceded * 1.0 / bw.wickets_taken AS bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN ipl.main.player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 12;
